overview: A penthouse terrace can account for more than half a quoted total. Compare enclosed accommodation and outdoor maintenance responsibilities before treating an apartment and a roof-level home as equivalent.
research.locationNote: Al Jaddaf, Dubai, in the creekside district. Actual views, transport access and road connections depend on the selected apartment.
research.priceNote: The Azizi-branded sheet lists studios from AED 824,000, one-bedroom homes from AED 1.3 million and two-bedroom homes from AED 1.7 million. It carries no visible issue date and permits changes. Property Finder separately retains AED 829,000 in its FAQ and changes its displayed unit selection; none establishes current stock.
research.paymentNote: The branded calendar totals 100%:10% on booking, 10% after 30 days, 1% monthly at the intervening stages, 5% at 210, 390 and 570 days, and 50% on handover. All day counts run from booking. Property Finder instead shows 10/60/30 and Bayut 70/30; those are separate published offers. Confirm the selected unit’s current signed terms and fees.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder targets December 2027/Q4 2027; Bayut gives Q3 2028. No later primary completion notice or contract resolves these references. Do not treat either forecast as actual completion or key delivery.
unresolved: Brochure studio sample says floors 11–13; the corresponding 326.26 sq ft technical example says 14–15. Confirm the selected unit’s approved plan.
Property Finder labels ownership leasehold in its key facts but freehold in its FAQ. Title rights require primary verification.

Current live availability, approved service/cooling charges, furnishing, parking allocation, construction status and private-pool responsibilities were not verified. Published sizes include outdoor space. Images remain illustrative.
